text.tspan: WHAT CHANGED vs R34: toilets use compact prefab modules (2.99×2.44 m, like your reference) stacked along the passage, doors on the passage; accessible
WC = 2.05×2.00 clear with Ø1.50 turning circle (your 2nd reference).
WC block now only 3.0 m wide (was 5.4 m); lockers 2.4 m each (was 2.8 m). Wet cluster (WC + showers) is all at the west end → one drain/riser zone next
SPACE GAINED: WC + lockers shrink from 59.8 m² (R34) to 44.6 m² → ≈ 15 m² freed → one 3.2×4.9 = 15.7 m² FOR-LEASE unit with shopfront on the aisle, plus
the gift shop (14.2 m²) and spare (7.8 m²) can also be let: ≈ 38 m² rentable.
FROZEN: S1 stair (x −1.80…3.20, y 30.10…32.80) and lift (x −3.80…−1.80, y 27.90…29.80). Passage narrowed to 1.50 m (x 0.40…1.90, still ≥ 1.20 m). Slab
edge x −1.80…22.20 untouched; grid naming as your R33 (A–E x, 4–5 y).
TO CONFIRM: (1) wet door to pool deck was dropped in the compact lockers — pool access via passage/rear door; (2) the Boulder room stays off the ground
floor unless the lease unit is used for it; (3) fixtures are schematic, fire exits / drains / ventilation still to be checked.
